module: Powertrain component `hydrodynamicRetarder`: hydrodynamic retarder (truck/bus engine brake) mounted as a branch on the shaft. It has a virtual rotor (inertia `virtualInertia`) whose speed `outputAV1` it integrates itself; it returns `inputAV = outputAV1 * gearRatio` to its parent. When the requested coefficient is > 0, it applies a braking torque read from the `brakeTorque` curve (torque according to the rotor speed), smoothed by `strengthSmoothing`. The dissipated power can be returned to the engine coolant (`thermals.additionalCoolantEnergyPerStep`). Categories `retarder` and `torqueConsumer`, without an output port.
usage:
local ret = powertrain.getDevice("retarder")
ret:setRetarderCoef(0.6) -- braking at 60 % (0..1)
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, friction (N·m), dynamicFriction, strengthSmoothing (10), gearRatio (1, ratio between input shaft and rotor), virtualInertia (kg·m², 0.1), torqueDropOffRange (RPM, default 500, min 10, rounded down), brakeTorque (table with header {rpm, torque}, REQUIRED, at least two rows, distinct rpm, torque in N·m), coolantEnergyCoef (0..1, default 1, share of the dissipated power sent to the coolant), breakTriggerBeam, retarderWhineEvent, retarderWhinePitchCoefSmoothing (100).

Main fields: inputAV (rad/s parent side), outputAV1 (rad/s, rotor speed), outputTorque1 (always 0), gearRatio, desiredRetarderCoef (0..1 requested by setRetarderCoef), brakeTorqueCurve (table keyed by integer rotor RPM, N·m), torqueDropOffRange, virtualInertia, invVirtualInertia, coolantEnergyCoef, cumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio, maxCumulativeGearRatio, isBroken.

The braking torque = -sign(rotorAV) * brakeTorqueCurve[|rotorRPM|] * smoothed coefficient. Beyond the last row of the curve, the torque decreases linearly to 0 over torqueDropOffRange RPM. The braking torque of the curve is tabulated in ROTOR RPM (outputAV1), not that of the input shaft.

validate returns false if the brakeTorque curve is missing or invalid: the device is then rejected. A broken rotor or one without a curve switches to updateTorqueBroken (the rotor accelerates freely without braking).
The thermal system is only fed if the propulsion engine (powertrain.getPropulsionDeviceForDevice) has thermals.additionalCoolantEnergyPerStep.

Minor bugs: the log messages cite 'hydrodynamicRetarder2.new' (old name); calculateInertia divides by gearRatio² without protecting against gearRatio == 0; M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs is not defined in this module; initSounds uses obj:createSFXSource (and not createSFXSource2).

new.desc: Builds the retarder: reads and validates the brakeTorque curve, builds the per-RPM curve with the decay zone, sets the virtual inertia and the smoothers.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (brakeTorque required).

device.desc: Object returned by new(jbeamData). velocityUpdate and torqueUpdate are set by selectUpdates.

setRetarderCoef.desc: Sets the requested braking force (0 = none, 1 = maximum of the curve). The actual torque follows via a smoother. To be called from a controller (retarder lever).

updateSounds.desc: Sets the volume, pitch and color of the retarder whine sound from the smoothed speed and the requested coefficient.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: inputAV = outputAV1 * gearRatio, written into the parent's speed field.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: integrates the rotor speed with the parent torque (minus friction) plus the braking torque, and adds the dissipated power to the energy of the cooling circuit. "Broken or no curve" version: without braking.

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases the damage friction coefficient (0.01 of damage = +0.1).

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (odometer, coefficient from 1 to 2) and damage (integrity number 0..1 or table {damageFrictionCoef, isBroken}); calls onBreak if isBroken.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity 0..1 (0 if broken) and {damageFrictionCoef, isBroken}.

validate.desc: Called after the powertrain is built; returns false if the brakeTorque curve is missing or invalid.

returns.desc: true if a valid braking curve exists.

onBreak.desc: Marks the retarder as broken and switches to the torque version without braking.

calculateInertia.desc: cumulativeInertia = virtualInertia / gearRatio²; cumulative ratios = gearRatio; computes invVirtualInertia.

initSounds.desc: Creates the retarder sound loop (disabled at start) and the speed smoother.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (retarderWhineEvent, retarderWhinePitchCoefSmoothing).

reset.desc: Resets speeds, torque, requested coefficient, smoother, wear/damage coefficients; rereads friction and dynamicFriction.
